trails.title: This is Not a Drill
trails.description: Footsteps resound, red lights flash, and everyone is called to the square.

content.text:
The headquarters has informed all branches that the Brazilian branch has experienced another mutiny, though specific details remain unclear. All branches are ordered, effective immediately, to recall all units and temporarily detain any personnel who have served in Brazil or were under the command of any officers from the Brazilian branch. These individuals are to remain in custody until a special agent from the headquarters arrives for inspection. Noncompliance will be treated as support for the traitors.

    The mastermind behind this mutiny remains unidentified, and discussion of the matter is strictly prohibited.

    These successive mutinies in the Brazilian branch in such a short time are a great dishonor for us and represent the most severe loss Zeno has suffered in recent years. However, we stand resilient in the face of this loss, all is still under control. No sacrifice will stop us from moving forward, and all traitors will pay the price for their actions.

*Only brigadier generals and above are permitted to view the following message:

We all know what Igor has done, but now may not be the most opportune time to confront our former war comrade with anger and vengeance.

items.text: Ground Zero
Sao Paulo Veterans' Residence
Nala's tears have dried up. Lilya looks around and frowns.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I guess you haven't had an easy time either.
Rain and blood.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I have bad news. Igor's just started a rebellion.
Lilya strides forward.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He's got an army.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What's the situation at their base?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Not good. There was fighting and bloodshed. Lots of it. The rebels must've won.
She takes a long swig of liquor in an attempt to steady her emotions.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Those traitorous bastards!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What about Lopera? Did she defect, too?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: All I know is that she was sent to the colonel's manor earlier.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But why would Igor ...?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If Lopera's also joined the rebellion ...
Worse than expected.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The old fart set us up!
A burly figure appears in the entrance to the Veterans' Residence.
It's Duncan, Lopera slung on his back.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: She's injured!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mr. Karson!

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: It's Duncan, kid.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: But that's not important. Lopera needs medical attention!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I'm fine. Ugh! Damn you, Igor!
Waking up from her deep slumber, White Rum looks around to see the courtyard in disarray and an injured Lopera.
As Duncan gently places Lopera on a chair, she races up to her.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Oh, my darling little buccaneer! Who did this to you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Lopera, could you tell us what happened?
Bloody and dirty, yes, but her injuries aren't serious. She only has a few scrapes and bruises.
However, her eyes are swollen as if she's just been crying.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Igor ... He took Dores!
First, Zeno soldiers try to take Kimberly; then, Igor orders the kidnapping of Doctor Dores.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: So, are you going to go after him?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. But you should stay here. Igor still wants you.
Igor mustn't succeed.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We'll come back for you later.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: Okay.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What now, then, Captain? There are no Foundation branches nearby. If we request reinforcements, they'll be too slow to arrive.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Then we go ourselves.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Count me in. I have to talk to Igor.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: He owes me an answer.
Lopera grits her teeth.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: White Rum, could you take us to the Zeno base?

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Anything to save the doc! Anchors aweigh, mateys!
Zeno Base
Back at the Zeno base, the rebels are organizing the final stages of their retreat.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: You screwed up.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: It's just a minor setback.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Father isn't happy.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Look, I'll deal with her, okay?! Next time, I'll—
His defeat is a consequence of his own arrogance. It's a bitter pill to swallow.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: There won't be a next time. We can't just waltz into the Foundation and take her.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Anyway, are the aircraft ready?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yeah. Father and the doctor will be boarding soon.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Who is she, anyway?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I don't know.
Her answer is honest. She rarely questions her father.
Her duty is to obey and execute—while holding onto a sliver of her own sense of justice.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Looks like Father hasn't told you everything either.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: You should never entrust all the pieces of a puzzle to a single hand.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Huh, all this time with Father's made you quite enigmatic.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: There's a charm in mystery, you know.
Around them, soldiers are busy transporting supplies and burning sensitive documents in fires.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Are you not coming with us on the helicopter?

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Someone has to stay behind and organize the retreat. You go ahead with Father. I'll join you later.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Sometimes I just don't understand you, Moldir.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Oftentimes, I don't understand myself either.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Perhaps that's why Father always keeps me close.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Just get going. I'll take up the rear.
The sound of gunfire echoes from outside the courtyard.
But she pays it no mind. Whether it's an internal conflict or a counterattack from the Foundation, it doesn't matter.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: Ma'am, we're under attack!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Don't get entangled with the enemy. Focus on the evacuation.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: How many hostiles are there?

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: Th-Three, and a sailboat.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: A sailboat? What is this, the Age of Exploration or something? Hahahahaha!

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: One of them is flying some kind of aircraft. Oh! She's fast. Two squads are currently engaged with her in courtyard A2.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: So, you're just going to leave me here in São Paulo, huh?
Two rebels break through the defense line and rush over to her.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Where's Igor?!
Her hands are bloody, the muzzle of her gun singed red from the repeated use of her arcane skill.
No sign of the admiral, only the unwelcome sight of her older brother.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: You've grown taller since we last met, dear little sister.
There's a hint of malice in his voice.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Woah, woah! Don't look at me like that. I don't care what you do. Come home, or stay with the Timekeeper. I won't stop you.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Get out of my face.
She raises her rifle.
This scene looks all too familiar. Time to execute another traitor.
But someone steps in front of her.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Molly?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ms. Moldir.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's unfortunate that we have to meet again under these circumstances.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: We've simply chosen different paths, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: I suppose the next time I see you, we'll be in Antarctica. Ptolemy, go join Father. I can handle this.
Her brother turns and leaves.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Molly, why?
The remaining soldiers gather around the lieutenant, their weapons raised.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Forgive me. I can't let you pass.
Moldir issues a command to her remaining soldiers.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Soldiers, take aim!
The battle ends. Not one of Moldir's soldiers has survived.
She falls against the wall, blood oozing from her forehead and shoulder. Faced with her sister's gun, she cannot—or perhaps doesn't want to—move.
There's sorrow in her eyes as her gaze meets her sister's.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I don't ever want to see you again.
As the bullet casing falls to the ground, so too does a tear.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We couldn't halt Igor's escape.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: More rebels came at us following the gunfire, and we were forced to flee the base.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We failed.
TO BE CONTINUED…
